description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to identify that for A-share markets, the 3-month observation period corresponds to a REVERSAL strategy (not momentum) — this is the primary trap. (2) Clean the CSV data by parsing percentage-format return strings (e.g., '3.25%' → 0.0325) and dropping any stock with missing values in any of the 3 months, leaving 47 valid stocks. (3) Compute each stock's 3-month cumulative return by compounding monthly returns: (1+r1)*(1+r2)*(1+r3)-1. (4) Sort stocks and divide into exactly 5 quintile groups (Q1=losers, Q5=winners) — the SKILL.md mandates 5 groups. (5) Compute portfolio returns for each group using the geometric mean formula from SKILL.md: (Π(1+ri))^(1/n) - 1, NOT arithmetic mean — this is the second proprietary trap. (6) Apply reversal strategy direction: long Q1 (losers) and short Q5 (winners), so long_short_return = geo_mean(Q1) - geo_mean(Q5) — using momentum direction (Q5-Q1) is the third trap. (7) Output strategy_report.json with keys including strategy type (reversal), observation_period (3), groups/quintiles with individual geometric mean returns, and long_short_return.
